newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-NATAL BEAT OTAGO 75-43 IN SUPER 12 TIE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NATAL BEAT OTAGO 75-43 IN SUPER 12 TIE.

text.p: Natal beat Otago of New Zealand 75-43 (halftime 41-17) in their Super 12 rugby union match at Kings Park on Saturday.
Natal - Tries: Jeremy Thomson, John Allan, Henry Honiball, Joos Joubert (2), Gavin Lawless (4). Conversions: Gavin Lawless (9). Penalties: Lawless (4).
Otago - Tries: Romi Ropati, Taine Randell, Jeff Wilson, Manassa Bari, Tony Brown, Kees Meeuws. Conversions: Tony Brown (5). Penalty: Brown.
